preflight: NCBI E-utilities esearch availability check for RNU5B-1 / ReNU transcriptomic data
purpose: Determine whether an accessible omics dataset exists to directly test RNU5B-1 variant-specific mis-splicing computationally, rather than relying only on literature.

sra_RNU5B-1.note: Non-specific: SRA full-text parsing returns essentially the whole archive; NOT a usable RNU5B-1-specific result set.

interpretation: As of 2026-10-19, NCBI GEO DataSets returns zero records for RNU5B-1, RNU4-2, or ReNU-syndrome splicing. No public, directly reusable processed transcriptomic dataset for RNU5B-1 (or RNU4-2) mis-splicing was found through GEO. Patient-level RNA-seq from the primary studies (Nava PMID:40379786; Dawes PMID:42856368) is expected to reside in controlled-access repositories (e.g., EGA) and/or journal supplements, which were NOT accessed in this run.
execution_outcome: succeeded (availability check); downstream re-analysis: SKIPPED (no accessible relevant dataset)
fallback_disclosure: No dataset was accessible for direct re-analysis of RNU5B-1 splicing; the report therefore relies on literature synthesis for the mechanistic claims. This is an explicit, disclosed limitation, not a silent fallback.
